purpose: Ensemble corners fixture: MOS inverter chain under PVT corner lanes.

oracle.derivation: Three level-1 CMOS inverters in a chain. Dropped 3 of 257 sample rows on switching edges, where the two converged references disagree by more than 0.5x the tolerance. Converged reference: Xyce at timeint reltol 1e-6, nonlinear reltol 1e-7 abstol 1e-15; the previous oracle (ngspice at the deck's options) was 3.99e+03x its tolerance off it on the rows kept. Samples: of 254 rows, 8 dropped on fast edges (within one TSTEP, 1e-08 s, either way the waveform moves more than a tenth of its swing, a default-options run misses by more than the tolerance, and a time shift within that TSTEP meets this value) and 1 where a default-options run is off by more than 1% of the column's swing (not settled for it); 245 kept. Each atol is 2x the largest deviation beyond rtol*|value| of ngspice-44.2 at the deck's options, Xyce 7.10.0 at its defaults from this reference on the rows kept, or the previous atol where larger.

confirmed.command: ngspice -b deck + .options reltol=1e-7 abstol=1e-15 vntol=1e-12 chgtol=1e-20, .tran tmax 4e-10
